pick.headline: Bosnia, Croatia and Slovenia admitted to the United Nations
pick.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of May 26, 1992, carried Zagreb Radio's live relay of Bosnian Foreign Minister Silajdzic addressing the UN General Assembly on May 22, welcoming membership and pleading for action against aggression.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: East Europe, No. 101, 26 May 1992
evidence.snippet: FBIS-EEU-92-101 26 May 1992 Foreign Minister Silajdzic Addresses UN Assembly LD2305083192 Zagreb Radio Croatia Network in Serbo-Croatian 1522 GMT 22 May 92 {Address by Foreign Minister Haris Silajdzic to the United Nations General Assembly in New York on 22 May—live, in English with superimposed Serbo- Croatian translation] [Text] Mr. President, Mr. secz..ary General, honorable members of the General Assembly: The late Dag Ham- marskjold…
